$comment: Contract for the UpdateSection server-side command (AD-003, AD-043, AD-123). Sections are not versioned, so the Audit Event's before/after is what preserves the trail. Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_UpdateSection
customApi.description: Amends a section's name, help text, owning team, display order or optional flag in place, recording the before and after of each changed field on an immutable Audit Event. Enforces Edit on question.retire.

requestParameters.name: SectionId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_section to amend.

requestParameters.name: HelpText
requestParameters.description: Optional. New guidance shown under the heading.

requestParameters.name: OwnerRole
requestParameters.description: Optional. 120910100 Tax, 120910101 AQS, or 120910105 Both. Retroactive: owner role is not versioned, so the change reaches submitted reviews.

requestParameters.name: DisplayOrder
requestParameters.description: Optional. New integer order within the checklist version.

requestParameters.name: IsOptional
requestParameters.description: Optional. 'true' or 'false'. Takes effect on every unsubmitted review immediately; there is no effective date on the flag.

requestParameters.name: Reason
requestParameters.description: Why the section is being amended. Required and recorded on the Audit Event.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same result.

responseProperties.name: Changes
responseProperties.description: The before and after of each changed field, as recorded on the Audit Event. Empty when nothing changed.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written, or empty when nothing changed.

responseProperties.name: Conflict
responseProperties.description: True when an optimistic-concurrency conflict was detected.
